=WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (rr.idea_id)
    rr.id,
    rr.idea_id,
    rr.keyword_cluster_id,
    rr.summary,
    rr.key_insights,
    rr.key_statistics,
    rr.trends,
    rr.sources,
    rr.research_json,
    rr.tokens_used,
    rr.cost_estimate,
    rr.created_at
  FROM research_reports rr
  WHERE rr.status = 'completed'
  ORDER BY rr.idea_id, rr.created_at DESC
)
SELECT
  i.id AS idea_id,
  i.idea_title,
  i.categoria,
  i.status AS idea_status,
  i.keyword_cluster_id,
  i.estimated_word_count,
  i.priority,
  i.description,
  k.cluster_name,
  k.keyword_principal,
  k.keywords_secundarias,
  k.project_name,
  latest.id AS research_report_id,
  latest.summary,
  latest.key_insights,
  latest.key_statistics,
  latest.trends,
  latest.sources,
  latest.research_json,
  latest.tokens_used,
  latest.cost_estimate,
  latest.created_at AS research_created_at
FROM latest
JOIN ideas i ON latest.idea_id = i.id
JOIN keywords k ON i.keyword_cluster_id = k.id
LEFT JOIN drafts d ON d.idea_id = i.id AND d.status NOT IN ('rejected')
WHERE i.categoria ILIKE 'Requiere%'
  AND i.status IN ('research_ready','research_completed','in_progress','pending')
{{ $json.body && $json.body.idea_id
    ? "  AND i.id = '" + $json.body.idea_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"
    : "" }}
{{ $json.body && $json.body.keyword_cluster_id
    ? "  AND i.keyword_cluster_id = '" + $json.body.keyword_cluster_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"
    : "" }}
{{ $json.body && $json.body.project_name
    ? "  AND k.project_name = '" + $json.body.project_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"
    : "" }}
{{ $json.body && $json.body.force ? "" : "  AND d.id IS NULL" }}
ORDER BY i.priority DESC NULLS LAST, latest.created_at ASC
{{ $json.body && $json.body.limit
    ? "LIMIT " + $json.body.limit
    : "LIMIT 3" }}

INSERT INTO drafts (
  idea_id,
  keyword_cluster_id,
  title,
  meta_title,
  meta_description,
  tags,
  content_markdown,
  word_count,
  research_data,
  research_sources,
  status
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid,
  $2::uuid,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6::text[],
  $7,
  $8,
  $9::jsonb,
  $10::jsonb,
  'draft'
)
RETURNING id, idea_id, keyword_cluster_id, title, meta_title, word_count, created_at;

=UPDATE ideas
SET 
  status = 'draft_created',
  processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  description = {{ $items("Construir Prompt Redaccion Investigada", 0)[$itemIndex].json.research_summary ? "'" + $items("Construir Prompt Redaccion Investigada", 0)[$itemIndex].json.research_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "description" }}
WHERE id = '{{ $json.idea_id }}'
RETURNING id, idea_title, status;

INSERT INTO jobs_log (
  job_name,
  job_type,
  status,
  related_keyword_id,
  related_idea_id,
  related_draft_id,
  input_data,
  output_data,
  completed_at
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4::uuid,
  $5::uuid,
  $6::uuid,
  $7::jsonb,
  $8::jsonb,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
RETURNING id;
